prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a red-skinned devil standing on two hooved legs, curled black ram horns, two black bat wings half raised behind the shoulders, a long thin barbed tail, two bright yellow eyes clearly visible and a fanged grin, a lean muscular body, holding one black iron trident in the hand on the right side of the image; centred in its own cell. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its red devil face with yellow eyes and a fanged grin under the ram horns is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward and stabbing the trident steeply down toward the heroes' feet in the same hand as in the idle cell, the trident angled down in front of its legs, its prongs well inside the middle cell (not reaching the cell edge), the wings spread, the same one trident as in the idle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the wings folding, the free arm thrown up, the trident held upright close to the body in the same hand as in the idle cell, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and thrust the trident with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. The two bat wings stay attached behind the shoulders in every cell (exactly two wings, as in the idle cell). Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak or cloth, and no smear, motion arc or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, grey stone skin, feathers, a cape, fire, a sword, a third wing, a second trident.
